svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Fig. M1 — Field lines of a bar magnet: one pair against four pairs of poles
contours of the flux function ψ = ρA_φ in a plane through the axis (axis horizontal, as in Russell's drawing); the bar is the grey outline
Uniform bar: magnetic charge on the two end faces — one pair; the outside lines run end to end
Four segments S N | N S | S N | N S: the lines bow from pole to pole along the axis — a chain of lenses
Field lines are contours of the flux function ψ; dots mark the magnetic charge −∇·M (orange N, black S). 400 sheet loops per bar.
